answer: Every agent identity pays a one-time sybil tax of 50 POA, burned at registration and logged on the public wharf ledger. Forging 1,000 fake identities burns 50,000 POA outright, while one honest agent pays only 50 POA once and keeps its full reward share undiluted. An ivory-list of verified payers lets peers refuse unpaid identities, and a bought account still carries its burned tax. Bulk forgery turns unprofitable; honest entry stays cheap.
